subject: hm-notes-documents
description: notes-sdk's documents (docs/formats/conformance.md). input.as names the format to read input.document as: hm-notes-notebook, hm-notes-page, hm-notes-library or hm-notes-backup. expected is the document as a reader writes it back, or the rejection. Positions and sizes are whole units, 100 to a PDF point, and times are whole milliseconds. Generated cases come from the property tests' generators, with a fixed seed.
